guidance: AGENTS.md:51: Rust modules target <500 lines, excluding tests
AGENTS.md:64-66: use original just fmt and just test; no direct cargo test
AGENTS.md:40-43: build-time file resources require build metadata where applicable; this is explicitly scoped Cargo workspace, not Bazel/whole-repo qualification
constraints.format_and_test_scope: Recorded real isolated-workspace fmt/test receipts cover declared build inputs. The superseded standalone pure-policy probe is a historical development helper, not a final owner/gate artifact. No executable checks rerun during publication preparation.
constraints.size_guidance_interpretation: The nine source groups are intended as separate stacked PRs; multiple commits inside one combined large logic PR do not alone satisfy the stated change-size guidance. Generated receipts/logs/archive parts are mechanical evidence.

materialization_note: Archive entries identify the exact reassembled local archive bytes. If root publishes verified parts instead of monolithic blobs, retain a part/reassembly index; this manifest does not assert a monolithic remote file already exists.
excluded: all non-native prefixed formal training/kernel/model source files and model files outside the native raw evidence archive
self_hash_note: This manifest excludes itself to avoid a recursive content hash; root may add its own Git blob identity after creating it.
